title: 第720章 寒星枪法第一式星殒第719章 快剑郭松
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
擂台上。
鬼算子眉头微皱，脸色有些难看。
如果洛星凝真的选择弃赛，这无疑是在挑战星斗天阙的招牌。
对于这种人，永久禁赛都是最轻的处罚。
“唉，这一次，少主算是看走眼了……”
鬼算子叹了口气，低声喃喃道。
已经过去二十息，洛星凝还没有出现。
这无疑是弃赛的表现。
与此同时。
观众席上。
“知微，我先下去了。”
“再不下去，这些人还真以为我害怕弃赛了。”
“嗯，对方看上去不弱，你自己小心。”
“放心吧，这一场擂台赛，我必赢！”
“我去了。”
话落。
洛星凝从座位上站起身。
然后。
她果断纵身一跃，朝着最下方的擂台落去。
这突然的一幕，瞬间引起在场所有人的注意。

“砰！”
随着一声巨响，洛星凝稳稳落在擂台之上，与对面的郭松各站一方。
“你是寒星？”
看着从上面跳下来的洛星凝，郭松一脸惊讶地问道。
他万万没有想到，自己的对手，竟然是名女子！
“是。”
洛星凝淡淡回应了一句。
一旁。
鬼算子上前，站在二人正中间。
“下面，我简单说一下擂台赛的规则。”
“任意一方掉落擂台，亦或是主动认输，又或是彻底失去抵抗能力。”
“只有这三种情况，意味着擂台赛分出胜负。”
“另外。”
“一旦分出胜负后，双方禁止继续出手，故意伤及对方性命。”
“一旦发生这种事情，轻则禁赛，重则当场镇杀！”
“你们，都明白了吧？”
话落。
鬼算子先后转头，看向站在两边的洛星凝，以及郭松。
二人没有任何的迟疑，皆是点了点头。
content_en:
In the arena.
The ghost fortune teller frowned slightly and looked a little ugly.
If Luo Xingning really chooses to give up, this will undoubtedly be a challenge to Xingdou Tianque.
For such people, permanent ban is the lightest punishment.
"Alas, this time, the young master made a mistake..."
The ghost teller sighed and murmured in a low voice.
Twenty breaths have passed and Luo Xingning has not appeared yet.
This is undoubtedly a sign of abandonment.
at the same time.
In the audience.
"Zhiwei, I'm going down first."
"If I don't go on, these people really think I'm afraid of quitting the game."
"Well, the other party doesn't look weak, so be careful."
"Don't worry, I will win this arena match!"
"I'm going."
The words fell.
Luo Xingning stood up from her seat.
Then.
She jumped decisively and fell towards the bottom of the ring.
This sudden scene instantly attracted the attention of everyone present.
"Bang!"
With a loud noise, Luo Xingning landed firmly on the ring, standing opposite Guo Song on each side.
"Are you Han Xing?"
Looking at Luo Xingning who jumped down from above, Guo Song asked in surprise.
He never expected that his opponent would be a woman!
"Yes."
Luo Xingning responded lightly.
aside.
The ghost teller stepped forward and stood in the middle of the two of them.
"Now, let me briefly explain the rules of the arena competition."
"Either party falls off the stage, or voluntarily admits defeat, or completely loses the ability to resist."
"Only these three situations mean that the winner will be determined in the arena competition."
"Besides."
"Once the winner is decided, both sides are prohibited from continuing to take action to intentionally harm the other party's life."
"Once something like this happens, it will range from being banned from the competition to being killed on the spot!"
"Do you all understand?"
The words fell.
The ghost teller turned his head one after another and looked at Luo Xingning and Guo Song who were standing on both sides.
The two of them nodded without any hesitation.
